01

AI-assisted animation passes paired with hands-on editors, so ideas move fast but nothing feels auto-generated.

02

From brief to render

The seven-step edit

A calm, repeatable rhythm — you always know exactly where your video is.

1

Brief

We align on goal, tone, references and deadline before a single clip is touched.

2

Storyboard

The shape of the edit — structure, hooks and beats — mapped out first.

3

Animations

Motion graphics, text and effects built with our presets and AI passes.

4

Sound design

SFX, music and mix layered in to make the cut land emotionally.

5

Review

You watch the first cut and mark anything that needs to shift.

6

Correction

We apply your notes — pacing, captions, timing — until it's right.

7

Render

Final export, platform-ready, delivered in the formats you need.
